title: DPWH eyes P20-B fund shift as House debates proposed 2027 budget

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) will ask lawmakers to shuffle roughly P20 billion in funding across its infrastructure projects, according to Surigao del Sur Rep. Romeo Momo, Sr. on Thursday. Momo, who sponsored the DPWH’s P643.95 billion proposed funding for next year, said the department will request the shift in project money through an institutional amendment as the House of Representatives debates the national spending plan on the congressional floor. “They have institutional amendments to be submitted to the committee on appropriations,” he told lawmakers.
